name: Ratchet
summary: Ships crowd Ratchet's docks on the eastern coast of the Barrens. The Steamwheedle Cartel runs this neutral port, linking central Kalimdor to the Eastern Kingdoms by sea.

sections.title: The Crossroads of the Great Sea
sections.body: Ratchet gives shelter to anyone who can pay, on the dry coast between Durotar and Dustwallow Marsh. After the Third War, chief engineer Gazlowe founded the port, drawing smugglers, exiles, and daring traders to Kalimdor's frontier. The Steamwheedle Cartel runs the town, which keeps strict neutrality between the Horde and the Alliance. Ships such as The Maiden's Fancy cross the Great Sea to Booty Bay with goods, mercenaries, and raw materials. Ratchet Bruisers watch the docks and beat anyone who starts a fight and disrupts trade.

sections.title: Shadows Above the Docks
sections.body: Ratchet's docks, taverns, and workshops serve a town with dealings beyond trade. A secluded tower overlooks the harbor from the hills, where warlocks including Strahad Farsan and Menara Voidrender gather. While townsfolk and sailors tend to cargo and goblin engineering, the warlocks commune with demonic forces without interference. The Steamwheedle Cartel does not enforce the moral restrictions found in traditional faction capitals.

aliases: who is in charge of ratchet
faq.answer: Chief Engineer Gazlowe runs Ratchet for the neutral Steamwheedle Cartel. He founded the town after Warchief Thrall paid him well to direct the construction of Orgrimmar's infrastructure.

faq.q: Can Alliance players visit Ratchet safely?
faq.answer: Yes. Ratchet is a neutral goblin port where Alliance and Horde travelers can use the inn, bank, vendors, flight paths, and ferry, as long as they remain on good terms with the Steamwheedle Cartel and attack no one in town.

faq.q: Where does the boat in Ratchet go?
aliases: where does the ratchet ship go
faq.answer: The Maiden's Fancy, docked at the southern pier, sails across the Great Sea to Booty Bay at the southern tip of Stranglethorn Vale. It is a major sea link between Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.

faq.q: Why are there warlocks in the hills above the town?
faq.answer: Warlocks gather in the tower overlooking Ratchet under figures such as Strahad Farsan and Menara Voidrender. The Steamwheedle Cartel's indifference to dark magic lets them teach apprentices and bind demons without interference from religious or civil authorities.

faq.q: What happens if I start a fight in Ratchet?
faq.answer: Ratchet Bruisers attack anyone who starts a fight, using heavy clubs and nets. Fighting disrupts business and quickly damages your standing with the Steamwheedle Cartel.

angles.text: As a warlock, you can train in the tower on the bluffs above Ratchet, where warlocks of many origins gather under Strahad Farsan and Menara Voidrender to master advanced demonic summoning.
As an Alliance adventurer, you can find a safe landing point in the hostile central Barrens at Ratchet, with boat transport and flight connections.
